category_title: Impulsive male students prone to rule-breaking and interruptions
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a circle participating in a philosophical discussion about whether there is life after death.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Welcome to our discussion circle. Today's question is: Is there life after death?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No way. When you're dead, you're just dead.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Someone else just shared that they believe in an afterlife. What do you think about that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: That's just a story people make up! It doesn't make any sense at all.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's wait and hear what the person next to you is saying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Interrupting loudly without waiting to be called) But they are wrong! You can't prove it! I'm telling you, there's nothing after you die!
